headline: South Asia: Pakistan carries out 'calibrated’ airstrikes against terrorist targets in border region with Afghanistan
script:
Good morning. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- South Asia: Pakistan carries out 'calibrated’ airstrikes against terrorist targets in border region with Afghanistan.
- Western Russia: Ukrainian forces destroy bridges near Polohy used by Russia for offensive towards Orikhiv – video.
- Asia: Some of China’s 11,000 mega bridges could be at risk from small drones: study.

Full breakdown follows.

NORTH AMERICA
The Caribbean - bottom line: Robinson hits back at recovery claims - Opposition finance spokesman warns of more pain ahead.
- Jamaica Gleaner, 6 hours ago: Robinson hits back at recovery claims - Opposition finance spokesman warns of more pain ahead.
Opposition Spokesman on Finance Julian Robinson is warning that there is trouble ahead for Jamaican households, countering reports that the country’s economy is recovering faster than projected. Robinson said the economy has contracted for the last three quarters and is projected to contract again for a fourth quarter. Addressing party supporters at the People’s National Party’s (PNP) 88th Annual Conference in Westmoreland on Sunday, he pointed to a near-eight per cent inflation rate, and a $28.7-billion revenue shortfall that forced $30 billion in new borrowing.

ASIA
South Asia - bottom line: Pakistan carries out 'calibrated’ airstrikes against terrorist targets in border region with Afghanistan.
- Dawn (Pakistan), just now: Pakistan carries out 'calibrated’ airstrikes against terrorist targets in border region with Afghanistan.
The information ministry confirmed on Monday that Pakistan had conducted airstrikes on terrorist sites “in the border region with Afghanistan”, killing more than 28 terrorists. The ministry stressed that the “calibrated” strikes were carried out “against the hideouts and safe havens of terrorist organisations responsible” for the recent multiple terrorist incidents in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 6 hours ago: Final frontiers.
IN his first term in office, US President Donald Trump announced the creation of the Space Force, a new branch of the US military to add to the existing army, navy, air force, etc. Now, in 2026, not only has the US announced for the first time that it has actually put weapons in space, it has also released the uniforms designed for the Space Force. To no one’s surprise, they look identical to the uniforms of the Imperial Navy in Star Wars. In case you’ve been exiled to Alpha Centauri for the last century, those were the Bad Guys.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 2 hours ago: Oil prices slide on hopes of diplomacy in Iran war.
Oil prices slid to their ​lowest in more than a week on Monday as investors hoped for diplomatic progress on the US-Israeli war on Iran due to this ‌week’s UN meeting and eyed a partial recovery in shipments from Saudi Arabia despite ongoing attacks by Yemen’s Houthis. Brent crude futures and US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude touched their lowest since September 10 earlier on Monday. The Brent contract for November was at $102.09 a barrel at 11:55am PKT, down $1.78, or 1.71 per cent, ​after settling 0.91pc lower on Friday.

During an intense fire exchange between a “security forces convoy and Khwarij”, 23-year-old Captain Abuzar Farooq from Gujranwala and 22-year-old Lieutenant Sheraz Babar of Chakwal, “who were leading their troops from the front, fought gallantly and paid the ultimate sacrifice and embraced martyrdom along with their four men”.
